Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Scottsdale hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 17 Scottsdale hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Evendo at 3, Billabook.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, klook at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Traveluro at 1. These are the Scottsdale rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 14 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Scottsdale hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($30 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 5% at Talking Stick Resort Hotel to 14% at Bespoke Inn Scottsdale. At 8 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
